title: Virtual Compute: standard unit rate
content:
## Meaning — standard unit rate

Virtual Compute standard unit rate: Standard primary usage rate in USD per primary usage unit before region factors; decimal.

## Tier values — standard unit rate

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — standard unit rate: 0.094.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — standard unit rate: 0.188.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — standard unit rate: 0.376.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — standard unit rate: 0.752.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — standard unit rate: 1.504.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — standard unit rate: 3.008.
